The '''Persavi system''' was located in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Persavi [[Star system/Legends|system]] followed the lead of the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Antar/Legends|Antar]], [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], and [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], which had previously [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|seceded]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and also broke its ties with the Republic. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which the Persavi system joined, came to heavily rely on the system's military forces during the former's conflict with the Republic.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Persavi system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the system in grid square Q-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
